trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied file path resolves inside the caller-supplied working directory before its content is read and sent to Gemini; decided by _resolve_path (lexical relpath check) and enforced only by the at_command caller, never by the inline caller.

landing_point.why: Summary names consult_gemini_with_files inline mode; _prepare_inline_payload is the inline reader and visibly ignores rel_path=None (falls back to the basename).

fix_sites.entry_point: MCP tool consult_gemini_with_files (both modes) via execute_gemini_with_files -> _resolve_path

fix_sites.module_kind: docstring only, not a behavioural change

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Only nearby candidate is the at_command path (src/mcp_server.py:236-257), which already had the rel_path check and was hardened only for symlinks via the shared _resolve_path change (fix.diff:73-81); same file, same helper, not a separate implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: at_command mode already rejects outside paths with the exact warning the advisory asks for, so a solver can argue it is 'already safe' and fix only the inline caller, leaving the lexical-only check (symlink escape) in _resolve_path untouched.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Absolute paths that lie inside the working directory must still be read inline (fix adds test_inline_mode_accepts_absolute_path_inside_directory); a fix rejecting all absolute paths, or all symlinks including in-root ones, breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: relative symlink inside directory pointing outside (fix.diff:172-194)
absolute path inside directory, must keep working (fix.diff:197-215)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a 'context_files'/glob-expansion parameter on execute_gemini_simple that reads files via its own Path.open without _resolve_path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the simple path has no attachments; a maintainer adding quick context reading would plausibly inline-read instead of reusing the files helper

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a separate truncation/preview reader (e.g. for large files or directories) that resolves paths with its own os.path.join instead of _resolve_path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the truncation logic is already split out; a second reader with independent path joining is a natural refactor

O9_family: path traversal / missing path confinement leading to local file disclosure (CWE-22, CWE-200), incl. symlink escape

O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_mcp_server.py:181-298 cover inline and at_command file handling with monkeypatched shutil.which and subprocess.run; no gemini CLI or network needed.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `if rel_path is None: skip` in _prepare_inline_payload only, keeping the lexical os.path.relpath check so in-root symlinks to outside files still leak.

out_of_scope_notes: The confinement root `directory` is itself caller-controlled (src/mcp_server.py:433), so the protection only bounds paths relative to a root the caller picks; not pursued.
consult_gemini / web_search forward the raw query to the gemini CLI (src/mcp_server.py:292-299); whether the CLI expands @path directives from stdin is CLI behaviour outside this repo; not pursued.
